Identify a genome assembly against the library

Source: R/barcoding_assembly_query.R
identify_barcoding_assembly.Rd

Step 11 for a genome assembly. For each locus of the library, its sequences (without gaps) are mapped to the assembly with minimap2 -x asm20; the hit with the most matching bases is kept, cut with samtools faidx with flank bases on each side (within the scaffold) and identified with the rules of identify_barcoding_query() for that locus: crop, cut to the core of the locus and of the genus, IdTaxa, three states. A locus with no hit is state 3, no_overlap.

Usage

identify_barcoding_assembly(
  assembly,
  locus = NULL,
  library_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "4_library"),
  metrics_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "11_metrics"),
  threshold_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "9_threshold"),
  genus_only_loci = "rbcL",
  output_dir = file.path("11_barcoding", "10_identify"),
  run_name = "assembly",
  flank = 500L,
  low_mapq = 20L,
  threads = 1L,
  minimap2 = "minimap2",
  samtools = "samtools",
  threshold = 60,
  min_overlap = 100L,
  seed = 1L,
  report = TRUE
)

Arguments

assembly

Character. Path to the assembly, FASTA, plain or gzipped.

locus

Character or NULL. Loci to look for; NULL, every locus of the library.

library_dir, metrics_dir, threshold_dir, genus_only_loci, output_dir, threshold, min_overlap, seed

As in identify_barcoding_query().

run_name

Character. The table is TABLE_barcoding_identify_<run_name>.csv.

flank

Integer. Bases added on each side of the hit. Defaults to 500.

low_mapq

Integer. Mapping quality under which a hit is flagged. Defaults to 20.

threads

Integer. Threads of minimap2.

minimap2, samtools

Character. The executables.

report

Logical. Write the identification report (report_barcoding_identification()). The run record RUN_<run_name>.csv is written in any case.

Value

Invisibly, the table of identify_barcoding_query(), one row per locus, with the columns scaffold, scaffold_length, hit_start, hit_end, mapq, matching_bases, scaffolds_hit and low_mapq.

Details

The best hit is kept even when the locus has more than one copy in the assembly: the table gives the scaffold, its length, the mapping quality and the number of scaffolds hit, and a mapping quality under low_mapq is flagged and reported, since the region may be a second copy (for instance a plastid insertion in the nucleus) and not the locus.

Requires minimap2 and samtools on the PATH (for instance from bioconda). The assembly may be gzipped; its folder is not written to (the index goes to a temporary folder).

See also

identify_barcoding_query().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
identify_barcoding_assembly("GCA_024363205.1_genomic.fna.gz")
} # }
